Privacy and safety

The public prototype is designed to demonstrate, not collect.

This page describes the public SafeNet demonstration at safe-net.pages.dev. It does not describe a future live support service, which would require separate governance, privacy documentation and institutional approval.

What this prototype does not collect

  • No names, email addresses, phone numbers or account creation.
  • No free-text disclosures, intimate images or uploaded evidence.
  • No analytics, advertising trackers or behavioural profiling.
  • No real support request or referral is sent from the demonstration.

What remains on the device

The service worker caches the public pages and demonstration assets so reviewed guidance can remain available when connectivity is interrupted. The demonstration reference is generated locally, is not saved by SafeNet and disappears when the page session ends.

Future live-service boundary

Any future support intake would run on a separately administered service and would not be stored on the campus gateway or local content cache. Live intake remains disabled until host approval, qualified supervision, verified referral routes, safeguarding procedures, security review and privacy review are complete.

Honest limits

Quick exit replaces the current page with neutral study resources, but it cannot erase browser history, network logs or traces controlled by another person or system. SafeNet does not promise invisible browsing, perfect anonymity or emergency rescue.
